subject: Albino Facehugger
promptProvenance: Source prompt hashes identify the production contract; actual ImageGen prompts are separately preserved in the production state.

physicalAnchorReview.method: Manual per-pose ventral central-body / walking-finger-root hub, vertically projected to the observed support plus extraction guard. Tail bounding-box centre is never the root. Attack uses the neighbouring grounded row plane: y422 for poses1-4, y377 for poses5-8, preserving the airborne arc. Other clips use their observed contact bounds.
